title: ReGTA CTW PC Recomp — First Look

scenes.label: FIRST LOOK
scenes.headline: Chinatown Wars. A native PC future.
scenes.voice: Chinatown Wars. Built for handhelds. Now, an independent project is bringing its PSP world to native PC. This is ReGTA CTW PC Recomp, by Benji Paname.

scenes.label: REAL PROTOTYPE FOOTAGE
scenes.headline: Back on the streets of Liberty City.
scenes.voice: You're watching the current prototype: exploring Liberty City, riding through its streets, and getting behind the wheel. Real gameplay, with plenty still to improve.

scenes.label: BUILT IN RUST
scenes.headline: Original PSP data. A native runtime.
scenes.voice: The runtime is written in Rust. It reads the world from your own PSP game image, without emulating the PSP processor.

scenes.label: THE VISION
scenes.headline: Bring the PSP experience together.
scenes.voice: The goal is to preserve the character of the PSP original, from movement and cameras to the city around you. Every detail needs research and comparison.

scenes.label: WORK IN PROGRESS
scenes.headline: An early build. A much bigger ambition.
scenes.voice: This is an early build, not a finished port. The full campaign, save compatibility, and closer gameplay fidelity are still ahead. No public playable release is available yet.

scenes.label: SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT
scenes.headline: Help make the next step possible.
scenes.voice: If you want to help this project move forward, follow the development and share it. Optional support on Tipeee or PayPal helps sustain the work. Links are in the description.

scenes.label: by Benji Paname
scenes.headline: Help build what comes next.
scenes.voice: Follow ReGTA CTW. Support the research. Help build what comes next.
